test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is INCORRECT about line standard?

options.text: Quick measurements over a wide range
More accurate due to line thickness
Used to measure the distance between two engraved lines

solution:
The correct answer is __More accurate due to line thickness.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Line standard__ is used to measure the distance between two engraved lines.
 
• It is prone to parallax error when measurements are not taken perpendicular to the scale.
 
• Line standards enable quick measurements over a wide range.
 
• The thickness of the lines can affect accuracy, making it less accurate compared to other methods.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Line Standard:**

 
 
• Line standards are primarily used for calibration and comparison purposes.
 
• They are implemented in tools like rulers, vernier calipers, and micrometers.
 
 
 
• **End Standard:**
 
 
• End standards use the ends of a bar or gauge blocks for measurement.
 
• They are highly accurate and used in precision engineering tasks.
 
 
 
• **Wavelength Standard:**
 
 
• Utilizes the wavelength of light for measurements, providing exceptional accuracy.
 
• It is often used in scientific and high-precision applications.
